listing.promotionalText: Plan all six men's events, see every counted decision, and keep routines private on your device.
listing.description:
D-Score Gymnastics is a fast, local-first routine planner for men's artistic gymnastics. Build counted routines for Floor Exercise, Pommel Horse, Still Rings, Vault, Parallel Bars, and Horizontal Bar under the 2025–2028 senior rules cycle.

Search a 738-element catalogue, organize complete six-event all-arounds, and see a live difficulty breakdown as you work. Clear explanations show counted and excluded elements, element-group credit, connections, Pommel Horse sequences, landing bonuses, and other apparatus-specific decisions.

Your routines stay on your device. There is no account, advertising, analytics, tracking, or cloud upload. Export a versioned backup whenever you want to protect or move your work.

D-Score Gymnastics calculates recognized-as-entered difficulty only. It does not judge execution, technical recognition from video, neutral deductions, or official competition results. Always resolve competition questions against current governing publications and qualified human judgment.

D-Score Gymnastics is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially authorized by World Gymnastics or the Fédération Internationale de Gymnastique (FIG).
listing.whatsNew: Initial release with all six men's artistic events, explained difficulty scoring, local routine and all-around libraries, offline support, and versioned backup and restore.
